ship_landlord.text: {greeting} The Ship Inn. Sir Francis Drake is said to have drunk here, and so did his cousin John Hawkins. Or so we've been saying for four hundred years.
The story goes that Drake said, next to his own ship, he loved the Ship in Exeter best. Nobody's ever found where he wrote it. We've never stopped quoting it.

ship_quiz.text: Pub quiz! West Country, history, and one about scones, because there's always one about scones.
